description:
Cargo bikes in three sizes.
From XS longtails to XL delivery and service carts, our CarGoAway platform offers the ultimate in utility and versatility.
All CarGoAway models are available with or without electric motor assist. For optimal performance, functionality, and value we recommend Shimano STEPS or Bosch Cargo E-bike drive systems with our cargo bike builds. Please inquire for information on building around other drive systems.
The CarGoAway Medium is designed around carrying 4 grocery bags in the front compartment (56x56x32cm high) and rear area that allows a small passenger to ride on the back. The passenger area can also be made to hold panniers if you desire. We have successfully tested this design with a gross weight over 400 lb.
The CarGoAway XL is designed around carrying 5-6 grocery bags in the front compartment (70x67x32cm high) and rear area that allows a small passenger to ride on the back. The passenger area can also be made to hold 4 panniers if you desire. We have successfully tested this design with a gross weight over 450 lb.
PLEASE NOTE: Thanks to the expanded availability of drive belts we have discontinued the use of mid-drive motors as shown here.
The Best Electric Cargo Bikes // Gessato.com
“The CarGoAway bike from Ti Cycles doesn’t just have an inspired name, but it also offers the perfect alternative to a four-wheel ride. Custom made and built to order, each bike comes with a range of practical features to make hauling tiny people or large bags as convenient and fun as possible. The bike is available in various sizes and configurations, providing a loading capacity of up to 300 lbs, a clean belt drive, solar battery charging systems, as well as front and rear cargo space. As a bonus and quality assurance, each bike is hand built in Portland, Oregon, USA. “
